primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." It's infuriating. You find the right property, do your due diligence, put in a fair offer — and lose to someone who'll never set foot in the building. Our off-the-plan Truganina warehouses are different. Priority goes to owner-occupiers, not speculators. No bidding wars. No getting outgunned. Just a fair price locked in before construction completes. 20km from Melbourne CBD, Princes Freeway access, near West Gate Tunnel. Built for businesses who actually use the space.
description: Owner-occupiers get priority — no more losing to developers with deeper pockets.
